messages:
Nikhil: Heads-up: scheduling a microgravity tilt (blue->green) for 2024-09-08T03:00Z. This bumps router affinity hash and pins a new routing-rule. Need rollback gates + who runs smoke.
Rae: I can run the smoke tests. Plan: 8 steps of 12.5% every 3m after a 10% warm for 12m. Keep a 1% canary seed after completion for 45m.
Owen: Oncall. Abort if p95 delta > 230ms for 4m OR 5xx > 0.8% over 3m OR misroute rate > 0.3% of sessions. Also watch region eu-west queue depth > 50s.
Priestley: Add infra check: node memory saturation > 90% for 5m abort. I'll pin router-release tag before start: `/router pin microgravity-20240908`
Deploy Bot: Shift scheduled by @Nikhil: shift-20240908-001. Plan: warm=10%(12m) then steps=[12.5,12.5,12.5,12.5,12.5,12.5,12.5,12.5] cadence=3m watchers=[Rae,Owen]. Preflight: routing diff OK; canary health PASS; pin status PENDING.
Priestley: Pinning now -> pinned.
Deploy Bot: Preflight COMPLETE: PASS. Reminder posted 30m before start.
Deploy Bot: Shift started. step=warm -> 10% warm. metrics: p95=105ms base=95ms delta=10ms err5xx=0.1% misroute=0%
Rae: auth smoke ok. session affinity smoke ok.
Deploy Bot: step=3 -> 35% health=ok p95=118ms err5xx=0.12% misroute=0.02%
Owen: seeing a small 5xx blip in pool-a, but under threshold. continuing.
Deploy Bot: step=6 -> 75% health=ok p95=140ms err5xx=0.4% misroute=0.08%
Rae: running post-step smoke now, auth flows pass.
Deploy Bot: step=8 -> 100% complete. shift-20240908-001 status: SUCCESS. Canary seed=1% for 45m.
Nikhil: Nice. Rae please post a one-line release note in #releases after the 45m guard period.
Owen: I'll keep an eye for regressions; abort will be `abort shift-20240908-001`.
Priestley: Unpin scheduled after 90m to avoid accidental drift.
Rae: Posting release note: "router: microgravity affinity update + routing-rule pin; no downtime observed."
Deploy Bot: Shift closed. All watchers cleared.
